# The Test Leak
// A test scene, and none of it is the game's story. The tests play it from the Leads menu to each of its endings:
// someone who comes over, a part that waits for someone else, a check with someone watching, a fight, a room of the
// story's own, endings by name, and a smaller side for someone who isn't the captain.
start: doorway

== doorway
? not captain -> heard
Naomi Cass is in your doorway, with one sleeve wet to the elbow.

@Naomi Cass: "There's a line weeping in the Aft Holds. I'm telling you first, because you're who it's for."

* new quest crew_test_leak: The Test Leak | Naomi Cass says a coolant line is weeping in the Aft Holds. | Find out how bad the leak is.

> Ask her how bad the leak is -> asked
> Tell her the line can wait -> waits

== asked
She holds up the sleeve, as evidence.

@Naomi Cass: "It beads along one joint, and it drips when the pumps run. I put a rag under it. The rag is not a repair."

* journal: Naomi Cass says a coolant line is weeping at one joint in the Aft Holds, and drips when the pumps run.

> Ask Chief Marrow about the line first -> marrow_first
> Go down with her now -> below

== marrow_first
He doesn't look up from the board until you've finished.

@Chief Engineer Dunn Marrow: "The Aft Holds? That joint's older than I am. It'll take a clamp, an hour, and somebody who isn't me, unless you ask nicely."

* flag marrow_asked

> [persuasion:moderate:marrow] Ask him to mend it himself -> marrow_yes | marrow_no
> Go down to the line -> below

== marrow_yes
@Chief Engineer Dunn Marrow: "Fine. An hour, and you owe me one. I'll write it down, so you don't have to remember."

=> Chief Marrow mended the line himself.

* ending marrow_mends_it: Chief Marrow mended the weeping line himself, and you owe him one.
* flag marrow_owed
* contact Chief Engineer Dunn Marrow friendly: You asked him to mend the line, and he did.
* xp 15: The line holds
END

== marrow_no
@Chief Engineer Dunn Marrow: "No. I've a board full of things that are worse. Take a clamp from the rack."

> Go down to the line -> below

== below
* raw set_scene {"area": "Under the Aft Holds", "kind": "ducts", "people": ["Naomi Cass"], "things": [{"name": "The weeping line", "look": "A coolant line, beaded along one joint, dripping onto a rag somebody put there."}]}
The crawlway under the Aft Holds is cold, and it smells of coolant. The line is where she said it was.

@Naomi Cass: "There. And don't put your hand under it. Something lives under it."

> [engineering:moderate] Patch the line yourself -> patched | patch_failed
> Look under the line -> rats ? not seen rats
> Seal the hold, and leave the line for later -> sealed

== rats
FIGHT scrap_rat: Something the size of a boot looks at yours.
  enemy_followers: scrap_rat
  why: guarding
  won -> rats_won
  lost -> rats_lost
  fled -> rats_fled

== rats_won
WITH: nobody
Whatever lived under the line doesn't any more.

* flag rats_cleared

> Back to the line -> below

== rats_lost
WITH: nobody
You come round with Naomi Cass holding the rag to your head, which is what the rag is for now.

* flag rats_cleared
* stress 3: Carried out from under a coolant line

> Back to the line -> below

== rats_fled
WITH: nobody
You back out the way you came, quickly.

* flag ran_from_rats

> Back to the line -> below

== patched
The clamp bites, the bead stops, and the rag stays dry for a whole minute.

@Naomi Cass: "It's holding." She sounds as if she'd expected to say something else.

* ending patch_it: You patched the weeping line in the Aft Holds with your own hands.
* flag line_patched
* contact Naomi Cass friendly: You went down and patched the line yourself.
* xp 20: The line holds
* journal: You patched the line under the Aft Holds yourself, with Naomi Cass holding the light.

> Climb back up -> back_up

== back_up
* raw set_scene {"area": "The Aft Holds", "people": []}
WITH: nobody
You come up through the hatch into the Aft Holds, with coolant on both sleeves.
END

== patch_failed
The clamp slips, and the bead becomes a thread.

@Naomi Cass: "That's worse. It was better before you helped."

* health -3: A faceful of coolant

> Seal the hold, and leave the line for later -> sealed
> Send for Chief Marrow -> marrow_comes

== marrow_comes
WITH: nobody
Chief Marrow comes down with a clamp and an opinion, and uses both.

* ending marrow_mends_it: Chief Marrow came down and mended the line, after you'd made it worse.
* flag marrow_owed
* xp 10: The line holds, with help
END

== sealed
WITH: nobody
You have the hold sealed, and the line goes on weeping behind a shut door.

* ending seal_the_hold: You sealed the Aft Holds and left the line for later.
* flag aft_hold_sealed
* xp 5: It's somebody's problem later
END

== waits
@Naomi Cass: "It can wait," she says, as if writing it down. "I'll tell the rag."

* ending let_it_run failed: You let the line run, and it failed in the night.
* contact Naomi Cass wary: You told her the leak could wait.
END

== heard
You're not the captain, and the leak isn't yours. Naomi Cass has told you about it anyway, on her way to tell someone else.

@Naomi Cass: "There's a line weeping in the Aft Holds. Nobody upstairs is listening. You'll do."

* new quest crew_test_leak: The Test Leak | Naomi Cass says a coolant line is weeping in the Aft Holds, and that nobody's listening. | Decide whether it's yours to do anything about.

> [stealth:moderate] Follow her down, without being seen going -> followed | lost_her
> Leave it to the officers -> left

== followed
* raw set_scene {"area": "Under the Aft Holds", "kind": "ducts", "people": ["Naomi Cass"]}
The crawlway under the Aft Holds is cold, and the line is where she said it was.

@Naomi Cass: "Hold that. No, the rag. I'm going for the chief."

> Hold the rag until Chief Marrow comes -> helped

== helped
WITH: nobody
You hold the rag for most of an hour. Chief Marrow mends the line without asking who you are.

* ending marrow_mends_it: Chief Marrow mended the line, and you held the rag until he came.
* flag leak_helper
* journal: You held a rag under a weeping line until Chief Marrow came to mend it.
* xp 10: The line holds
END

== lost_her
WITH: nobody
She's through a hatch you didn't know was there before you've decided which way she went.

> Leave it to the officers -> left

== left
WITH: nobody
You leave it to the officers. The line goes on weeping.

* ending let_it_run failed: You left the leak to the officers, and nobody mended it.
END
